briefingProfile.mission: Replace browsing X with a broad, information-dense briefing of everything genuinely useful, novel, surprising, or interesting in the sampled feed.
prioritize: concrete facts, releases, claims, techniques, resources, firsthand observations, substantive arguments, and genuinely novel ideas
AI models, agents, tools, research, infrastructure, benchmarks, and useful demos
software, open-source projects, developer tools, hardware, security, science, and engineering
products, startups, business, markets, platforms, and policy
strong explainers, useful recommendations, design, media, culture, and surprising original observations
deprioritize: pure spam, affiliate promotion, engagement bait, and contextless reactions with no standalone information
exact repetition that adds no facts, perspective, source, or useful detail
